reflux_why: The plants do the work after the cast: a patch planted at the start of a fight is still working at the end of it. Little spent heat for what you get, and the price is time and place instead: growth is slow to pay out, and weak on stone floors.
rule: Nature plants growth in the ground that stays, spreads and grows stronger with age (sprout, grown, bloom); its skills plant it, feed it or cash it in.
rule_why: design/14 said what Nature plants stays, spreads and gets stronger over time. This makes that countable: a patch has three ages that scale its effect, it puts out one new patch every 5 s once grown, one caster keeps at most 12, and it only spreads on open ground. That gives Nature a place-dependence like water's wetness (strong in scrub and swamp, weaker in the city and the dungeon) and gives fire a reason to matter to it (Alight burns growth away).

skills.name: Heartwood
skills.summary: Point, 8 m: a sapling bursts up into a tree trunk in 0.6 s, shoving anyone standing there aside for 25. It blocks walking and shots for 30 s, gets tougher every second it stands, and every 5 s spreads a bramble patch at its foot. One at a time.
skills.verb_fit: Grow makes a thing larger and stronger. A seedling becomes a trunk in a breath, and it goes on growing for as long as it stands.

new_mechanics.name: growth
new_mechanics.definition: A patch of the caster's plants, 2 m across, of one kind (bramble or snarevine). Ages: sprout (0-5 s) x1, grown (5-15 s) x1.5, bloom (15 s on) x2 to its effect. Every 5 s each grown or bloom patch puts out one new sprout patch beside it, until the caster has 12; on paved or rock floors (biome key soil false) patches grow but never spread. A patch lasts until it is wilted, burned (an Alight enemy or fire skill on it burns it away in 2 s) or the level is left. Enemies route round growth as costly ground.

new_mechanics.name: bramble
new_mechanics.definition: A growth kind: enemies inside are Slowed and take 6 damage a second while they move (times the patch's age).

new_mechanics.name: growing prop
new_mechanics.definition: A prop key: hp_per_s adds to its health while it stands; spread_every drops a growth patch of spread_kind at its base (counted in the caster's 12).

good_modifiers.word: an old tree: half as long again
a thriving trunk: 30% longer, 10% harder as it rises
a broader trunk: 30% wider and further, a little softer as it rises
planted deep: a slower rise, a harder shove, a longer life

bad_modifiers.why: making smaller the thing that is Grow. The numbers would land (Dwindled on whoever it shoves) but the verbs cancel; the word should not form.
a wilting tree. The rise hits 15% harder but the trunk lives 30% shorter; the word kills what it grows.

skills.name: Dwindling Gall
skills.summary: A gall-vine takes root in one enemy within 9 m and shrinks it for 8 s: 20 damage, it counts one weight class lighter (shoves move it, Aloft lifts it), and its reach is cut by 30%. When it dies, the gall falls and grows a bramble patch.
skills.verb_fit: Shrink makes a thing smaller. A plant does it: a gall that feeds on its host, and stays in the world when the host is gone.

new_mechanics.name: hex
new_mechanics.definition: Defined in blood.json (gullet_knot): a target within range takes on_hit at once, no travel, needs line of sight.

new_mechanics.name: dwindled
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, lasts the skill's duration: the target counts one weight class lighter (elite as heavy, heavy as light) for shove_resist and Aloft, and its attack reach x0.7.

good_modifiers.word: a slow gall: half as long again
rooted from 40% further away
shrunk and held: Dwindled and Rooted together

bad_modifiers.why: making larger the thing you are shrinking. The numbers would land (more range, more damage, dearer) but the verbs cancel; the word should not form.
a hex is not a shot; pierce falls back to a small damage bonus.

skills.name: Thornburst
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: after 0.35 s thorns burst up from the ground. 60 and Slowed to everything within 1.5 m, and the thorns stay as a bramble patch that spreads and thickens the longer it stands.
skills.verb_fit: Sprout is growing plants from the ground. The hit is the plants coming up; what is left afterwards is the plants.

new_mechanics.name: leave_growth
new_mechanics.definition: A skill key: where the skill lands it plants a growth patch of that kind (defined under heartwood).

good_modifiers.word: the shoots grab: Rooted as well as Slowed
a bigger burst: 20% wider and 10% harder, a little dearer
it comes up sooner: a quarter less delay
a wider bed of thorns: 30% larger, a little softer

bad_modifiers.why: killing the plants the skill grows. The 15% damage would land, but the word contradicts itself; there is no duration field, so that half falls back.
a burst from the ground is not a shot; pierce falls back to a small damage bonus.

skills.name: Sere Ground
skills.summary: Point, 10 m: every patch of your growth within 4 m dies at once, and everything standing in one takes 30 (45 if the patch was grown, 60 if in bloom). The ground is clear again.
skills.verb_fit: Wilt is killing plants and clearing ground. You give up growth you planted, and its dying is the damage.

new_mechanics.name: field_pulse
new_mechanics.definition: Defined in death.json (lay_to_rest): acts on the caster's own field pieces within radius; here each growth patch is removed and pays per_stack_damage (times its age) to every enemy standing in it.

good_modifiers.word: a wider clearing: 30% more reach, a little softer
all of it at once: 20% harder, 10% dearer
it dies of a blight that jumps to them: Blighted on everyone caught
a violent clearing: 20% harder, 10% dearer

bad_modifiers.why: growing what you are killing. Slowed would land on those caught, but the word contradicts itself; there is no duration here, so that half falls back.
strengthening growth as you kill it. The 10% damage lands, the word contradicts itself, and the duration half falls back.

skills.name: Greening
skills.summary: Every patch of your growth within 12 m grows one age at once and puts out a new patch, and for 6 s all of it works 50% harder.
skills.verb_fit: Flourish is thriving: strengthening what grows. It makes your planted growth older, bigger and stronger at once.

new_mechanics.name: field_pulse
new_mechanics.definition: Defined in death.json (lay_to_rest); here it advances each growth patch ages_added ages, makes it spread spreads times at once (still capped at 12), and multiplies its effect by effect_mult for duration.

good_modifiers.word: a long season: half as long again
the greening reaches 30% further
the ground remembers: 30% longer

bad_modifiers.why: killing what you make thrive. The 30% shorter duration lands, the word contradicts itself, and the damage half falls back to a small cost change.
a sickness of growing things on the skill that makes them thrive. Greening hits nobody, so it falls back to a small cost cut.

skills.name: Heartrot
skills.summary: One enemy within 9 m, then two more within 5 m of each other: 40 each and Blighted for 8 s. The wood they carry rots: shields stop half as much and bows take half again as long to aim, and Nature hits them 20% harder.
skills.verb_fit: Blight is a sickness of growing things. It does not sicken the man; it rots the wood in his hands, and it spreads from one piece of wood to the next.

new_mechanics.name: blighted
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, lasts the skill's duration: the target's front_block is halved and its ranged aim (wind-up) is x1.5, because its wooden shield and bow are rotting; it takes x1.2 from Nature.

good_modifiers.word: it spreads to one more, each a little weaker
the rot lasts half as long again
it jumps 30% further
the rot shrinks what it reaches: Dwindled as well

bad_modifiers.why: making thrive the wood you are rotting. The numbers would land (harder, longer) but the verbs cancel; the word should not form.
freeing what the rot binds. The 1 m shove would land on each body it reaches; the wind-up half falls back. The word says nothing about blight.

skills.name: Reaping Sweep
skills.summary: A wide scything sweep through 180 degrees: 1.8x strike damage. Each patch of your growth in the arc is cut back to a sprout and adds 15% to the blow (up to 60%) and 1 essence to you; the roots stay and regrow.
skills.verb_fit: Harvest is taking what has grown and its yield. The sweep is a reaping, and what it reaps from your growth comes back to you as power and essence.

new_mechanics.name: harvest
new_mechanics.definition: A melee_burst key: each growth patch inside the arc is reset to sprout age (not removed), adds patch_bonus to the blow's damage up to patch_bonus_max, and returns per_patch_essence.

good_modifiers.word: a wider swathe: 30% more reach, a little softer
a bigger scythe: 20% longer and 10% harder, a little dearer
a cutting stroke: 30% more poise damage
the cut stalks catch their legs: Rooted on everything hit

bad_modifiers.why: planting and reaping in one stroke. The numbers would land (a slower, harder sweep) but the verbs cancel; the sweep has no duration, so that part falls back.
pierce means nothing on a sweep; it falls back to a small damage bonus.

skills.name: Scatter Seed
skills.summary: Throw five seeds over a 2.5 m spread at a point within 9 m. Each lies hidden until an enemy steps on it (or for 6 s), then bursts up: 35 damage and Rooted for 1 s, and a snarevine patch that stays and spreads.
skills.verb_fit: Sow is planting a thing to act later. The seeds do nothing when they land; they act when the ground is stepped on, or when they are ready.

new_mechanics.name: seed
new_mechanics.definition: A new kind: drops `seeds` hidden seeds spread over radius around the aimed point. Each sprouts when an enemy comes within trigger_radius, or after delay: on_hit to everyone within burst_radius, and it plants leave_growth. Unsprouted seeds wither after duration.

new_mechanics.name: snarevine
new_mechanics.definition: A growth kind: an enemy that enters it is Rooted for 1 s (times the patch's age), once every 4 s per enemy.

new_mechanics.name: rooted
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, 1 s unless the skill says otherwise: the target cannot move or turn, but can still strike what is already in reach. Heavy enemies are held half as long, elites a quarter.

good_modifiers.word: seed flung wider: 30% larger spread, each a little weaker
bigger seeds: 20% wider spread and 10% harder, a little dearer
seeds that wait half as long again for a foot
quick seed: they sprout on their own a quarter sooner

bad_modifiers.why: reaping seed before it has grown. The numbers would land (harder, cheaper) but the verbs cancel; the word should not form.
seeds that die in the ground. The bursts hit 15% harder but the seeds wait 30% less; the word kills what it plants.

skills.name: Vine Reach
skills.summary: A vine lashes out to a point within 9 m and hauls you there. Enemies within 1.5 m of where you land are Rooted for 1 s, and a snarevine patch takes root on the spot.
skills.verb_fit: Tangle is vines binding. The vine binds to a point and pulls you to it, then binds whatever is standing there.

new_mechanics.name: grapple
new_mechanics.definition: A new movement kind: like a blink it needs a reachable point within range (checked before essence is spent), but the caster is moved there by exact distance at dash_speed, stopping at walls and stone; counts as a dash for recovery and Winded; on_arrive to enemies within arrive_radius.

good_modifiers.word: a longer vine: 40% further
a faster haul: 25% quicker
a longer, thicker vine: 20% further, a little dearer
shoots come up where you land: Slowed as well as Rooted

bad_modifiers.why: a vine that lets go of what it is holding. The 1 m shove would land on the enemies beside you and push them out of the Rooted hold the vine is meant to put on them; the wind-up half has nothing to cut and falls back.
held in place, on the skill that moves you. It slows the haul by 20%, and the duration half has nothing to lengthen and falls back to a small cost cut.

skills.name: Unwinding
skills.summary: Every enemy your vines are holding within 10 m is let go at once and whipped 3 m away from you, for 40 (and a Crush if it hits something). Anything holding you lets go too.
skills.verb_fit: Unravel is freeing what is bound. Your vines unwind all at once, and the unwinding is the throw; you come loose in the same moment.

new_mechanics.name: frees_caster
new_mechanics.definition: A skill key: on cast, the player's own holds (slowed, pinned, mired, rooted and any later hold status) are removed.

good_modifiers.word: a harder whip: 1.5 m further
the vines let go 30% further out, a little softer
they are flung up as well as out: Aloft
a violent unwinding: 20% harder, 10% dearer

bad_modifiers.why: binding again what you release. Rooted would land on everything it throws, and the two verbs cancel.
pulling in what you are flinging out. The pull lands against the shove; the word contradicts itself.

effects.Grow: reach x1.2; power x1.1; cost x1.1
effects.Sow: windup x1.3; power x1.25; duration x1.2
